headline: The Grand Slam of Darts quarter-finals start at 2:00 PM New York time today, before a Saturday of the first T20I, England v New Zealand and Arsenal at Newcastle.
today: 2:00 PM: Grand Slam of Darts quarter-finals (Wattimena v Doets, Price v Springer), ESPN+/Hulu Live.

recaps.text: Tom Sykes beat Luke Humphries 10-9 in a last-leg decider at the Grand Slam of Darts, a day after Luke Littler went out, and meets Michael van Gerwen in Saturday's quarter-finals.
England beat Australia by 97 runs in Hobart on Wednesday to win the ODI series 2-1, Ben Duckett making 133.
Wakamotoharu leads the Kyushu sumo basho alone at 11-1 after day 12, a win clear of Onosato, Atamifuji and Kinbozan.

lookAhead: Saturday has the first T20I from the MCG at 3:15 AM, England v New Zealand at 9:10 AM and Arsenal at Newcastle at 12:30 PM; Sunday has Manchester United at Liverpool at 11:30 AM, the Grand Slam final at 2:30 PM and the Jets at the Chargers at 4:05 PM.
